plugins.name: arkandia
plugins.description: Arkandia's toolkit of AI coding-agent skills: `agent-context` generates AGENTS.md and supporting docs (architecture, ADRs, data model, infrastructure) for any repository; `agent-context-dotnet` adds a specialized .NET deep-dive. Both validate key generated claims with you to cut hallucinations. Supports Java, .NET, PHP, Python, Node, Go, Rust, Ruby. English or Spanish output.
